Camille.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistances, and Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health, so do not stack too much health. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Camille.combo: Build stacks on minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then pull Camille in with the shockwave and proc the mark with an attack. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun her, weave in an attack, then use K'Sante R All Out to push her toward a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, keeping in mind that K'Sante W Path Maker has no stun or push during R All Out.
Camille.phase: Camille is weak before her first core item, but K'Sante is not a champion who wins by forcing lane pressure in the early game. In the mid game, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger as K'Sante builds defensive items. In the late game, focus on engage and crowd control more than damage. After the mid game, do not leave the side lane unattended, so you can stop Camille’s fast tower destruction.
Camille.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. If Camille E Hookshot catches an ally, use K'Sante E Footwork to reach and shield them, or stop the engage with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker. If your allies cannot follow up or Camille’s main crowd control is still available, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line.
Camille.escape: Do not commit deeply just because Camille E Hookshot is down; check whether Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is available too. The best opening is especially before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back. Then close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork, and catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Camille.fight: Slow Camille with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage when she retaliates. Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. After Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is down, fight back by absorbing her retaliation with K'Sante W Path Maker.
Camille.laning: Keep the wave in the center and stand away from walls. Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build shockwave stacks in advance. When Camille moves through the wave, catch her with the prepared shockwave, but keep K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging by default.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to engage from long range and stun you, so stand away from walls. When her hook attaches to a wall, interrupt the dash with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave or the forced movement from K'Sante W Path Maker. Keep your distance while Camille Q Precision Protocol’s empowered attack is being prepared, and do not waste crowd control as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages.

Singed.fight: Slow Singed with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he retaliates. If Singed E Fling is down and you're away from Singed W Mega Adhesive, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and engage. As the enemy's retaliation comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack.
Singed.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Singed's main damage is magic and K'Sante's base magic resistance is low, pick up Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes also gains damage and a lower cooldown from magic resistance.
Singed.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Singed in with the shockwave. Proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack, then stun Singed with K'Sante W Path Maker and use K'Sante R All Out when you can push him into a wall. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Singed.escape: You can't use movement abilities such as K'Sante E Footwork on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so engage from a clear area. Your opening is after Singed E Fling is used: catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave.
Singed.laning: Keep the wave near the center, secure last hits, and hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build shockwave stacks.
Singed.phase: In mid game, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger as defensive items stack up. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Singed.teamfight: Instead of chasing Singed to the end, lock him down with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes or K'Sante W Path Maker and deal with his allies in the meantime. Before using K'Sante R All Out to separate a backline damage dealer, check that your allies are close enough to follow up immediately. K'Sante R All Out makes you less durable and removes K'Sante W Path Maker's stun, so use the crowd control you need first and engage after Singed's main crowd control is down.
Singed.watch: Don't chase Singed when his health is low while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can't use movement abilities on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and Singed E Fling roots you if he throws you while you're on it, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back to an allied group, check your position because Singed E Fling can throw you into that formation.

Aatrox.teamfight: If your allies are close enough to follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. If your allies are not ready, save R and hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker. After activating R, you become less durable and W loses its push and stun, so focus on staying close and attacking.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. As you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes also gains damage and a shorter cooldown. If Aatrox’s healing makes extended fights difficult, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Aatrox.combo: Before a fight, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare stacks. Pull Aatrox in with the shockwave, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then, near a wall, push him away with K'Sante R All Out. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and Q. Weave in attacks between abilities to proc the mark.
Aatrox.escape: Right after Aatrox uses E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and follow with K'Sante W Path Maker. Use K'Sante R All Out when Aatrox’s main crowd control is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Aatrox.fight: Trade briefly right after Aatrox uses an empowered attack on a minion. Slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his retaliation. When Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to mitigate the damage and trade back.
Aatrox.laning: Build Q stacks on minions in advance so you can catch Aatrox with the shockwave when he moves through the wave. Avoid giving up an early kill, farm, and watch for jungle intervention.
Aatrox.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as he builds defensive items. In the late game, contribute through engage and crowd control more than damage.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals the main damage and can knock you up. When you see the cast animation, move outside the blade’s tip range or close in toward him. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately, using your saved K'Sante E Footwork if needed.

Chogath.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. Use K'Sante R All Out when Cho'Gath’s main crowd control, such as Q Rupture and W Feral Scream, is down. If your allies are not ready, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and W Path Maker stun.
Chogath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage to withstand the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Keep in mind that magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.combo: Just before a fight, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Once Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream are down, pull him in with an empowered K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then push him toward a wall with K'Sante R All Out. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in attacks between abilities to proc the mark.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so the opening to engage comes after you dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is down. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and follow with K'Sante W Path Maker, but keep K'Sante E Footwork available for disengaging if he retaliates.
Chogath.fight: Look to engage after dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture or when Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is down. Use K'Sante R All Out after Cho'Gath’s main crowd control is down, when you can push him into a wall and follow up in close combat.
Chogath.laning: Pressure Cho'Gath or look for jungle intervention right after he uses Q Rupture on the wave to slow his growth.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks, so limit his growth from the early game. In the late game, K'Sante should focus on engage and crowd control.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture telegraphs on the ground, so dodge to the side immediately and save K'Sante E Footwork for this. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you and prevents you from using mobility, so avoid facing him directly. If it hits you, walk out first. If your health is half or less, move out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Gwen.teamfight: Build magic resistance against Gwen’s magic damage based on maximum health, and stay out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team and isolate them. If your allies are not ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker.
Gwen.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage against Gwen’s magic damage, but build some armor as well to handle her basic attacks. If Gwen’s healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Gwen.combo: Pre-stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, pull Gwen in with the shockwave, then recover the mark with a basic attack. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker and weave in a basic attack, then, near a wall, use K'Sante R All Out to knock her away. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, recovering marks between abilities.
Gwen.escape: The moment after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down is an opening to engage; catch her then with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. To charge K'Sante W Path Maker for a long time, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash must be down or Gwen must already be caught by the shockwave. Use K'Sante R All Out when Gwen’s main crowd control is down and your allies can follow immediately.
Gwen.fight: Do not engage when Gwen Q Snip Snip! has full stacks. Fight before she builds stacks or right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. For short trades, slow her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, recover the mark with a basic attack, then disengage from her retaliation with K'Sante E Footwork. When Gwen starts her combo, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and retaliate.
Gwen.laning: Before fighting, stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions so you can catch Gwen with the shockwave when she engages. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash gets a large cooldown refund when it hits something, so do not chase her where there are many minions.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, contribute through engaging and crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Gwen.watch: Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage in the center of its cone, so sidestep to avoid the center. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, so do not try to survive by stacking health alone. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.

Kennen.watch: Stand behind minions because Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm applies two marks, back off to avoid being stunned by the third. Don't stand clumped with allies when Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom engages.
Kennen.build: Kennen deals mostly magic damage, and K'Sante has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. Magic resistance also improves the damage and cooldown of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Kennen.combo: Just before fighting, hit a minion with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Kennen in with the shockwave, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall and follow with K'Sante E Footwork and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to proc the mark from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct.
Kennen.escape: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush is down is an opportunity to close the gap. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm could still stun you, back off first and wait for the marks to disappear. Once the stun threat is gone and Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close in with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and hit him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Kennen.fight: Save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging until Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. When Kennen gets close, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with a basic attack, then disengage with K'Sante E Footwork if he retaliates. If Kennen overcommits with Kennen E Lightning Rush, engage then.
Kennen.laning: Keep the wave in the center and block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions; step out briefly only to last-hit. If Kennen moves between minions, build stacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and look for the shockwave.
Kennen.phase: Mid game, while your defensive items are building, is K'Sante's strong point. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and use vision to block Kennen's approach. Before then, hold the frontline with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from K'Sante W Path Maker.

Nasus.teamfight: Don't stand your ground against Nasus while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. If your allies can follow immediately, look for a chance to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them with K'Sante R All Out. If your team isn't ready, hold the frontline with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from K'Sante W Path Maker.
Nasus.build: Nasus's main damage comes from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so build armor first. Defensive items also help K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes damage and cooldown. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so don't stay in its area.
Nasus.combo: Just before fighting, hit a minion with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Nasus in with the shockwave, then proc the mark from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct with a basic attack and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. If you can push him into a wall and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is not active, follow with K'Sante R All Out, then close in with K'Sante E Footwork, basic attacks, and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so look for an angle to catch him after Nasus W Wither is down. Catch him first with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then follow with K'Sante W Path Maker. Save K'Sante E Footwork by default so you can avoid his retaliation.
Nasus.fight: Slow Nasus with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then proc the mark from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct with a basic attack. If he retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't continue the fight.
Nasus.laning: If you push the wave under Nasus's turret, it'll be easier for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so keep the wave in the center or on your side. Last-hit with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and pressure Nasus when he steps up to hit minions. If the wave pushes toward your side, you can call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks remain, putting you at an increasing disadvantage as time passes, so slow his growth from the early game.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks permanently, so don't let him last-hit freely. Don't fight alone while affected by Nasus W Wither; create distance with K'Sante E Footwork. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid a head-on fight and wait out its duration.

Renekton.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. If your allies aren't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun. If an ally is caught, follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and shield them.
Renekton.build: Build armor first to prepare for the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek is a problem, slot Executioner's Calling between your defensive items. Renekton's fury-empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice shreds armor, so position to dodge the dash instead of stacking more armor.
Renekton.combo: Before trading, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Renekton in with the shockwave, then stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker and use K'Sante R All Out to push him toward a wall. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork, chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and proc the mark with basic attacks between abilities.
Renekton.escape: Engage after Renekton E Slice and Dice is used and Renekton W Ruthless Predator has also been used. Close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork, then catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Use K'Sante R All Out when the enemy's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Renekton.fight: When Renekton is out of fury, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he retaliates. As Renekton's combo comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack. After Renekton E Slice and Dice is used, close the gap and catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Renekton.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, but don't stand in or behind a minion wave that Renekton can use as a launchpad for Renekton E Slice and Dice. When Renekton steps forward to build fury, poke him with your prepared shockwave and keep farming without giving him a kill.
Renekton.phase: In mid game, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a lower cooldown as defensive items stack up, while Renekton becomes less valuable. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Renekton.watch: Watch for Renekton's empowered W Ruthless Predator when Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or just below half fury. This ability breaks shields before stunning, so don't rely on K'Sante E Footwork's shield to withstand it. Avoid standing in or behind a minion wave that Renekton can use as a launchpad for Renekton E Slice and Dice.

Sion.teamfight: If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team. K'Sante R All Out makes you more vulnerable, so use it after Sion's main crowd control is down. If your allies aren't ready, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun, and use K'Sante E Footwork to shield an ally who is caught.
Sion.build: Buy a defensive item first and prioritize armor. Sion's main damage sources—Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught—deal physical damage, and armor also improves K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' damage and cooldown. Avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor; armor cannot block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Sion.combo: Before a fight, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Sion in with the shockwave, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then basic attack again. If Sion's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow, use K'Sante R All Out to push him into a wall, close in with K'Sante E Footwork, and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Sion.escape: The window to engage is when Sion's mobility tool, Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, is down. If you've also dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash, close the distance with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Using K'Sante E Footwork first leaves you without an escape, so usually save it until you need to dodge his counterattack.
Sion.fight: When Sion Q Decimating Smash comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and trade back. For a short trade, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his counterattack. Look to engage when Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down and you've dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Sion.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare stacks, then catch Sion with the shockwave when he moves between minions. Sion's maximum health keeps increasing as he kills units, so if you can't safely disrupt his farming, take an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage, and don't let Sion keep farming for free while you stall.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks you up and stuns you if charged for long, so move sideways as soon as the charge starts. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught sideways too, rather than running directly toward or away from him, and avoid meeting him in narrow passages. After Sion goes down, reposition because Sion P Glory in Death revives him and lets him attack quickly.

Udyr.teamfight: Instead of forcing a fight with Udyr, who has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, target weaker enemies behind him. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them. If your allies aren't ready, save R All Out and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and W Path Maker stun.
Udyr.build: Prioritize armor against Udyr's main damage. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage, so consider magic resistance too. Since K'Sante's Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a shorter cooldown as his armor and magic resistance increase, build mainly defensive items.
Udyr.combo: Build K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes stacks on minions in advance, then pull Udyr in with the shockwave and stun him. Follow with a K'Sante W Path Maker stun, then use K'Sante R All Out near a wall to take advantage of the terrain; close in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks with Q Ntofo Strikes. Fit basic attacks between abilities to retrieve your K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark.
Udyr.escape: Right after making Udyr use E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the distance with K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork. If you've already absorbed the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you can counterattack, but immobilizing effects don't work during its Awakened effect, so catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes after it ends. When you need to escape, save K'Sante E Footwork or crowd control instead of trying to run on foot.
Udyr.fight: For a short trade, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, then disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. Your window to counterattack is after you've absorbed the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede once or just made him use the dash. When Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield expires, burst him and don't give him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and prepare stacks while last-hitting with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Udyr can appear from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don't move forward when he isn't visible. Generally save K'Sante E Footwork to disengage.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede's fast dash and stun are dangerous, so charge K'Sante W Path Maker as he rushes in to reduce the damage and absorb the stun. During Udyr E Blazing Stampede's Awakened effect, immobilizing effects don't work, so use the crowd control from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and K'Sante W Path Maker after the effect ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and watch out for R's slow.

Yorick.laning: Don't force the wave forward, but when you can push, send it to the enemy turret so Yorick can't clear minions on his side and build graves. Step forward to farm after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Yorick.teamfight: Use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team if your allies can follow immediately. If they aren't ready, hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun. Clear Yorick's ghouls first, and account for your reduced durability during K'Sante R All Out when fighting up close.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so engage when Yorick W Dark Procession is down and Yorick E Mourning Mist has missed. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork if needed. K'Sante R All Out reduces your defenses, so use it after the enemy's main crowd control is down.
Yorick.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his ghouls. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Yorick.combo: Before a fight, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Yorick in with the empowered K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then chain a basic attack, K'Sante W Path Maker's stun, and another basic attack. If you can push him into a wall and safely stay in close combat, use K'Sante R All Out, follow with K'Sante E Footwork, and retrieve the mark with a basic attack between each ability.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and retrieve the mark from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct with a basic attack. If he retaliates, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and fight back, keeping K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging. Clear the ghouls before fighting, and target Yorick himself when the Maiden of the Mist is separated from him.
Yorick.phase: K'Sante is strong in the midgame as defensive items come together. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and reduces armor, creating an opening for his ghouls to rush in, so dodge the projectile's path. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, look for a way to break the wall with attacks or reach an ally outside it with K'Sante E Footwork instead of immediately using a mobility ability. If a mark appears on the Maiden of the Mist, create distance from Yorick to avoid the extra damage.

Darius.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. If your allies are not ready, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and W Path Maker stun. Do not remain within range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine while Darius P Hemorrhage is stacked and give him an opportunity to chain kills.
Darius.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Build health as well to account for Darius E Apprehend’s armor penetration and the true damage from R Noxian Guillotine. If healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Darius.combo: Before a fight, build stacks on minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then pull Darius in with the shockwave and proc the mark with an attack. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun him and an attack, then use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall and chase with K'Sante E Footwork, attacks, and Q. During R All Out, K'Sante W Path Maker no longer stuns, so use the crowd control needed to catch him first.
Darius.escape: The opening to engage comes when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Use K'Sante R All Out when Darius E Apprehend is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Darius.fight: When Darius E Apprehend is down, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his retaliation. Right after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions is another chance to harass. Avoid extended fights that build Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, and back off until the stacks disappear.
Darius.laning: Build stacks by hitting minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, but do not force your way into range of Darius E Apprehend.
Darius.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as he builds defensive items. In the late game, focus on engage and crowd control more than damage.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you are likely to take follow-up attacks, so harass from outside its range. When he casts it, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to respond to the damage and crowd control. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or stay close to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage has stacked heavily or your health is low enough for Darius R Noxian Guillotine to kill you, create distance completely.

Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave centered and away from walls, and use K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to last-hit. Last-hit outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes when she comes through the minions. If you can fight when your spirit is pulled out, retaliate; if not, break the link and dodge the first tentacle.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi’s tentacles when you can; otherwise, draw her away from walls. Do not group up against Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its duration. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team. Otherwise, hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker.
Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, so do not stack a lot of health alone. If her healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Illaoi.combo: Before fighting, stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions to prepare the shockwave. Once Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, pull her in with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and stun her, then recover the mark with a basic attack before stunning her again with K'Sante W Path Maker. If you can knock Illaoi toward a wall and Illaoi E Test of Spirit is down, follow with K'Sante R All Out, then close in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Illaoi.escape: The moment after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is an opening to engage. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and use K'Sante W Path Maker to retaliate. Use K'Sante R All Out when her main ability is down and your allies can follow immediately.
Illaoi.fight: For short trades, slow Illaoi with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, recover the mark with a basic attack, then disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. Right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork and catch her with Q Ntofo Strikes. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, do not fight for long near her tentacles.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes deals more damage and has a shorter cooldown. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control.
Illaoi.watch: Your priority is to dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, do not fight near her tentacles; spread out and wait out its duration. Charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage from Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, then retaliate.

Kled.teamfight: Get vision on the flank where Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! may come from. If you can't stop the charge, stand in front to protect your backline's formation. If your allies can follow up immediately, knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them with K'Sante R All Out. If your team isn't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from K'Sante W Path Maker.
Kled.escape: Don't rush your engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; Kled can still escape with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Look for an opening when Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is not ready and you've also avoided the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and engage. Use K'Sante R All Out when Kled's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health. Attack speed reduction can buy you time to get away before Kled's fourth basic attack from W Violent Tendencies.
Kled.combo: Hit a minion with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then pull Kled in with the shockwave. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun him. When he's near a wall, knock him into it with K'Sante R All Out, then close back in with K'Sante E Footwork. Proc the mark from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct with basic attacks between abilities, and chain Q with basic attacks.
Kled.fight: If Kled retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork, and engage after Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down. Avoid extended basic-attack trades if Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready.
Kled.laning: Keep the wave in the center, last-hit with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and hit minions to prepare stacks for the shockwave. Catch Kled with the shockwave when he moves between minions, but don't force a push or start an extended fight early on. After knocking Kled off Skaarl, push Kled away from the wave so he can't build courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Kled gets weaker after lane and mid game, so contribute in the late game with K'Sante's engage and crowd control.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use K'Sante E Footwork to create distance before you get pulled in. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off so you don't take the fourth basic attack, which deals damage based on your maximum health, then re-engage. When Kled comes in with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack.

Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance, so dodging Olaf Q Undertow and preventing him from retrieving the axe creates an opening to engage. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, retreat behind a wall or your allies first and wait out its duration, then catch him as soon as it ends with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker.
Olaf.teamfight: If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't try to catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker; create distance and wait out its duration. If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and separate them. If your team isn't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline, using K'Sante E Footwork to reach an ally who's been caught and shield them.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. However, Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and Olaf E Reckless Swing can't be mitigated by armor, so also build health. Consider attack speed reduction to take fewer basic attacks.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, hit him with the shockwave using the stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes you built in advance, pull him in, and proc the mark with a basic attack. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun him, weave in a basic attack, then use K'Sante R All Out to push him toward a wall. During All Out, close back in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes with basic attacks.
Olaf.fight: Dodge Olaf Q Undertow and prevent him from retrieving the axe, then slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack. If he retaliates, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage or disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. Catch him with K'Sante's movement impairments and engage after Olaf R Ragnarok ends.
Olaf.laning: Keep the wave in the center and build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions in advance, so you're ready to use the shockwave when Olaf comes in. Move to the opposite side of Olaf Q Undertow's dropped axe to prevent him from retrieving it, and don't give up an early kill.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is relatively weak in the late game, so K'Sante should contribute through engage and crowd control rather than damage.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so move to the opposite side of the dropped axe to prevent him from retrieving it. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the movement impairments from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, W Path Maker, and R All Out won't work, so create distance. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don't rely on armor alone when your health is low.

Riven.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. If Riven engages on an ally, interrupt her combo with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker, and use K'Sante E Footwork to reach and shield your ally. If your allies can't follow up or Riven's main crowd control is still available, save R and hold the frontline.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are dashes, so back off when you see the first dash. After Riven closes in, watch for the knockup from her third Q and the stun from Riven W Ki Burst, and charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce incoming damage. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and its execute damage grows with the target's missing health, so keep your distance until it ends.
Riven.build: Riven deals physical damage, so build armor first. Defensive items also help K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes deal more damage and reduce its cooldown. Build some health as well to account for the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, pull Riven in with the shockwave, then proc the mark with a basic attack and stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker. If Riven's main crowd control is down and you can push her into a wall, use K'Sante R All Out, then follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and Q. During All Out, W no longer knocks enemies back or stuns them, so use the crowd control you need before R.
Riven.escape: The window to engage is before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up; if Riven E Valor is down too, she has even fewer ways to escape. Catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes then, and follow up with K'Sante W Path Maker. Be cautious about engaging with K'Sante R All Out if the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings and the stun from Riven W Ki Burst are still available.
Riven.fight: Slow Riven with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if she retaliates. Look to trade when Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear minions, but check whether Riven E Valor is still available. If Riven closes in and starts her combo, absorb it with K'Sante W Path Maker.
Riven.laning: Just before a fight, hit minions with Q to build stacks. When Riven engages, pull her in with the shockwave and stun her. Before moving far beyond vision, check whether Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are still available.
Riven.phase: In mid game, make use of the stronger Q from your defensive items. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.

Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance from Skarner and his allies so Skarner R Impale can't drag you deep into the enemy team. If your allies can follow immediately and Skarner's main crowd control is down, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them. If you don't have that angle, save R and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun.
Skarner.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to counter Skarner's main damage, then choose Mercury's Treads. Keep prioritizing magic resistance afterward, but remember that it cannot block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Skarner.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions and Skarner with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then pull him in with the shockwave and retrieve your mark with a basic attack. Follow with a K'Sante W Path Maker stun and another basic attack, then use K'Sante R All Out to push him toward a wall and chase with K'Sante E Footwork, Q, and basic attacks. W does not stun during R All Out, so use the crowd control needed to catch him before R.
Skarner.escape: The window to engage is right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Close the distance with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Use K'Sante R All Out when Skarner's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow immediately.
Skarner.fight: While Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his counterattack. Right after Skarner dashes in with E, absorb his counterattack with K'Sante W Path Maker, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and fight.
Skarner.laning: Hit minions with Q to build stacks in advance, then look for the shockwave when Skarner moves between minions. Stay wary of positioning with your back to a wall and of Skarner's jungle ganks.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, contest objectives so Skarner has less time to build items, while K'Sante focuses on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Skarner.watch: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact carries you into a wall, you're stunned, so don't stand with your back to one. K'Sante E Footwork cannot break the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so watch for its range when Skarner approaches.

Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so you can stand on the frontline to protect allies behind you. Use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team if your allies can follow immediately. If your allies aren't ready or Urgot's main crowd control is still available, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and K'Sante W Path Maker.
Urgot.build: Since Urgot's main damage is physical, build armor first. K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a shorter cooldown as your armor and magic resistance increase, so focus on defensive items. Since Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with your max health, avoid stacking health alone and also consider having enough health to survive the execute threshold of Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Urgot.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Urgot in with the shockwave. Retrieve the mark with a basic attack, then stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. Follow with a basic attack and push Urgot into a wall with K'Sante R All Out, then close back in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. During K'Sante R All Out, K'Sante W Path Maker's stun and knockback are unavailable, so use those abilities to catch him beforehand.
Urgot.escape: The window to engage opens right after Urgot uses Urgot E Disdain. Close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork, then catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge has already hit and you can barely move, quickly decide whether to escape with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork.
Urgot.fight: Don't stay in close combat from the front for long while Urgot E Disdain is available. For a short trade, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve the mark with a basic attack, then disengage from his retaliation with K'Sante E Footwork. Once Urgot E Disdain is down, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, reduce the damage with K'Sante W Path Maker, and retaliate.
Urgot.laning: Just before a fight, use K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions to build a shockwave charge. Staying near Urgot for too long lets his leg cannons' damage add up, so focus on farming and preparing for jungle pressure instead of forcing repeated trades.
Urgot.phase: K'Sante is strong in the midgame as defensive items come together. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you’re heavily slowed and become the target of Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to dodge it with K'Sante E Footwork as it comes in. If you’re hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get completely out of range before you reach the execution threshold.

Fiora.laning: Build stacks in advance by hitting minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then catch Fiora with the shockwave when she moves through the wave. After a short trade, do not chase too far and watch for enemy jungle intervention.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall so you do not expose all four vitals. If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. If your allies are not ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge deal true damage that resistances cannot block, and Fiora R Grand Challenge also deals damage based on maximum health, so do not stack large amounts of health alone. If healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Fiora.combo: Bait out Fiora W Riposte first, then pull her in with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave when Fiora Q Lunge is down. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun her, then use K'Sante R All Out to push her toward a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in attacks between abilities to proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora Q Lunge is down is your chance to close the gap. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, approach with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and land K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Use K'Sante R All Out when Fiora’s Riposte is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Fiora.fight: When Fiora approaches from the direction of a vital, stand on the opposite side to narrow her angle and retaliate. Slow her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage when she retaliates. Only commit deeply after Fiora Q Lunge is down and Fiora W Riposte is unavailable.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects. If it blocks an immobilizing effect, it can stun K'Sante. While Riposte is available, do not use the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave, K'Sante W Path Maker, or K'Sante R All Out carelessly, and sidestep Riposte’s counterstrike. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall to block one vital.

DrMundo.teamfight: Look for another target instead of spending a long time attacking Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active. If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them. If your allies are not ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to mitigate the damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, his main source of damage. If his healing makes duels prolonged, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items. Build magic resistance if the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper becomes a problem.
DrMundo.combo: Build stacks on minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare the shockwave. Use it to remove Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases first, then stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker and use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in attacks between abilities to proc the mark.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability that creates distance on its own, so catch him after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is also down, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to look for a fight. Keep K'Sante E Footwork available by default to disengage from retaliation.
DrMundo.fight: Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases blocks the first immobilizing effect, so make him use it first, then catch him with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante R All Out. For a short trade, follow K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes with an attack to proc the mark, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his retaliation. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down, look to engage with K'Sante R All Out using the terrain.
DrMundo.laning: Build stacks on minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in advance so you are ready to use the shockwave when Dr. Mundo approaches. After trading, step on the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases as you retreat to prevent the healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: K'Sante gets stronger in the mid game as he builds defensive items. In the late game, focus on engage and crowd control more than damage.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it collides with and scales with current health, so when your health is high, avoid it especially by keeping minions between you and him. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowers his basic attacks. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so do not focus on killing him during that time.

Malphite.escape: Malphite R can't be interrupted while dashing, so charge K'Sante W Path Maker as he comes in to reduce the damage, then counterattack once the dash ends. Use K'Sante R All Out when the enemy's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't knock up several of you, then counterattack as soon as it's down. If your allies can follow up immediately, knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them with K'Sante R All Out. If your team isn't ready, save R and hold the frontline with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun.
Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade right after it hits. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by crowd control, so watch bushes and areas behind walls when you can't see him, and keep your distance from allies.
Malphite.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malphite's main damage is magic, so get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. K'Sante also benefits in K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes damage and cooldown from building magic resistance.
Malphite.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Malphite in with the shockwave and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. Follow with K'Sante R All Out toward a wall, close back in with K'Sante E Footwork, and chain basic attacks with Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to proc the mark.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start chipping away at his actual health. Slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack; disengage with K'Sante E Footwork if he retaliates. After Malphite uses R Unstoppable Force, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and start a fight.
Malphite.laning: You can't dodge Malphite Q Seismic Shard from behind minions, so don't stay within its range for long.
Malphite.phase: K'Sante is strong in mid game as defensive items build up, and contributes in the late game through engage and crowd control rather than damage.

Rumble.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. Check that you won't be caught by Rumble E Electro Harpoon or Rumble R The Equalizer as you engage, and absorb Rumble's damage with K'Sante W Path Maker. If your allies can't follow up, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun.
Rumble.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Rumble's main damage is magic, prioritize magic resistance and pick up Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Rumble in with the shockwave. Stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, and if you get an angle toward a wall, use K'Sante R All Out to push him into it. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in a basic attack each time you land an ability to proc the mark.
Rumble.escape: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage before the second shot. Look to engage after Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble W Scrap Shield are used. Rumble has no mobility spell, so catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave or K'Sante W Path Maker then.
Rumble.fight: Limit the time you're in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter, and fight from a position that forces Rumble to walk forward. For short trades, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he retaliates. If Rumble activates W Scrap Shield, save your heavy damage until the shield ends, then catch him after he uses his escape tool.
Rumble.laning: Build stacks in advance by hitting minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then catch Rumble with the shockwave when he moves between minions. Hold your ground and watch for the enemy jungler instead of forcing the wave forward or taking frequent trades.
Rumble.phase: In mid game, as magic resistance items stack up, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a lower cooldown. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Rumble.watch: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use K'Sante E Footwork to create distance before the second shot. Getting hit by both shots applies a stronger slow and reduces your magic resistance, making you more vulnerable to Rumble Q Flamespitter. Be careful not to stay in range of Q Flamespitter while slowed by Rumble R The Equalizer.

TahmKench.teamfight: If you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies so it doesn't knock up several of you. Target the backline damage dealers rather than trying to kill Tahm Kench first, but account for the chance of a rescue if Tahm Kench R Devour is available. If your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's main crowd control is down, use K'Sante R All Out to push a backline damage dealer toward them. If the target is swallowed, focus your damage on Tahm Kench; if you have no engage angle, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun.
TahmKench.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Tahm Kench's main damage is magic, so get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. If his healing makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
TahmKench.combo: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then pull Tahm Kench in with the shockwave. Retrieve your mark with a basic attack, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then basic attack again. If Tahm Kench's main crowd control is down and you have an angle to a wall, use K'Sante R All Out to push him in, follow with K'Sante E Footwork, and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time both engaging and escaping, so look for a chance to catch him then. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks and the threat of a stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash has passed, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. If he counterattacks, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce and absorb the damage, and save K'Sante E Footwork as an escape.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns damage into a shield or healing, so don't get stuck in a pattern of small hit-and-run trades. A safe trade is to slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage from his counterattack. Engage if Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, you have no stacks, and you can burst him all at once.
TahmKench.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare stacks, then catch Tahm Kench with the shockwave when he moves between minions. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, stop fighting and wait out the stacks from outside his range.
TahmKench.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains both damage and a shorter cooldown. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, create distance and wait for the stacks to disappear. A third basic attack or a hit from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash opens up a stun and a chance for Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up.

Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear P The Relentless Storm is fully stacked, don't fight him right away; engage after the stacks expire. Use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team when your allies can follow immediately. If your allies aren't ready, save R and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun, then use K'Sante E Footwork to reach an ally who's been engaged on and shield them.
Volibear.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and Volibear E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone won't stop them. Since Volibear E Sky Splitter scales with your max health, avoid investing heavily in health alone. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Volibear.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions ahead of time, then pull Volibear in with the shockwave. Retrieve the mark with a basic attack, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then push him toward terrain with K'Sante R All Out. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork to close in and chain basic attacks and Q, retrieving the mark with a basic attack between each ability.
Volibear.escape: Don't rush in when only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down; he can escape with Volibear R Stormbringer. Look to engage during the window when both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and his stun are down, especially before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork, and use K'Sante R All Out after Volibear's main crowd control is down.
Volibear.fight: Slow Volibear with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and retrieve the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he retaliates. Don't use K'Sante E Footwork to engage first while Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer is available. Close in and fight when Volibear's mobility is down and you have K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave ready.
Volibear.laning: Before a trade, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare a shockwave charge, then catch Volibear when he moves between minions. Avoid fighting while he approaches and builds stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm; fight after those stacks expire.
Volibear.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear activates Volibear Q Thundering Smash and runs at you, stay out of his basic attack range. As his stun is about to hit, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and retaliate. When you see Volibear E Sky Splitter's marker, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow. While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don't rely on having low health under your turret; fall back farther in, and when you see him leap, use K'Sante E Footwork to get out of the landing area.

Akali.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. During R All Out, K'Sante’s maximum health and bonus resistances are greatly reduced, so choose your engage distance carefully. If your allies are not ready, save R and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun. Use K'Sante E Footwork to reach and shield an ally who has been caught.
Akali.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali’s main damage is magic, and K'Sante has low magic resistance, so prioritize Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage.
Akali.combo: Before a fight, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. Pull Akali in with the Q shockwave, stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out near a wall to push her beyond the terrain. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain Q and attacks. Weave in attacks between abilities to proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark.
Akali.escape: Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip being down create an opening to engage. Akali can escape if she still has one mobility ability, so look especially for a window when Akali R Perfect Execution is also down. Catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork.
Akali.fight: Slow Akali with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage when she retaliates. Trade back when Akali misses Akali E Shuriken Flip or comes at you after leaving Akali W Twilight Shroud. When her combo comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to mitigate the damage. Charge it for longer when Akali’s mobility is down or you have caught her with the Q shockwave.
Akali.laning: Build Q stacks on minions in advance, then catch Akali with the shockwave when she moves through the wave.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger. In the late game, focus on engage and crowd control more than damage.
Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows you even if you try to escape. If you are hit, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to mitigate the incoming damage and prepare to retaliate.

Irelia.teamfight: When Irelia engages, protect your allies by locking her down first with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker. Before using K'Sante R All Out to isolate an enemy backline damage dealer, make sure your allies are close enough to follow immediately. If your allies are not ready or Irelia still has her main crowd control, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line.
Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and W Defiant Dance. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Irelia.combo: Before fighting, stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, pull Irelia in with the shockwave, then stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker. If Irelia has her back to a wall and her main crowd control is down, use K'Sante R All Out to knock her into the wall, then follow with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to recover K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct marks.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is an opening to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork and catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Irelia.fight: Slow Irelia with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover the mark with a basic attack, then disengage from her retaliation with K'Sante E Footwork. Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. When she retaliates, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and retaliate.
Irelia.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as defensive items stack. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge lets her repeatedly approach using low-health minions and heals her, so step back when minions are close to dying. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge’s perimeter, wait until the blades disappear.

Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the line between Ornn and the elemental summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and watch for the elemental's return charge after it passes. If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. If your allies aren't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun.
Ornn.build: Build defensive items first to improve both K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' damage and cooldown. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Since Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, avoid stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Ornn in with the shockwave and stun him. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun him again, then use K'Sante R All Out to push him into a wall if he has his back to one and his main crowd control is down. Re-engage with K'Sante E Footwork, chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and proc the mark with basic attacks between abilities.
Ornn.escape: Don't engage carelessly just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Look for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes off cooldown and his main crowd control is down, then catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to engage. K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, and K'Sante R All Out can help close the gap.
Ornn.fight: Slow Ornn with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if Ornn retaliates. Right after Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is used, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and fight. As Ornn's retaliation comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack.
Ornn.laning: Before trading, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare a shockwave. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, attack to interrupt him when you can safely close in.
Ornn.phase: Mid game is when K'Sante gets stronger as defensive items stack up. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage. Press your advantage before Ornn completes more items and upgrades his allies' masterwork items.
Ornn.watch: Stand clear of terrain walls and the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits a pillar or wall, so dodge toward open space when he lines up the dash. If Ornn W Bellows Breath's final flame makes you Brittle, don't move forward; keep your distance.

Sett.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. If your allies aren't ready or Sett's main crowd control is still available, hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun. Avoid standing on top of your allies to reduce the risk of Sett R The Show Stopper grabbing and throwing you toward them.
Sett.build: Build armor first to prepare for Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, and resistance doesn't reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so avoid stacking health alone. K'Sante also gains damage and a lower cooldown on K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes from armor.
Sett.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Sett in with the shockwave and proc the mark with a basic attack. Stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out when you can push him toward a wall. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. During All Out, K'Sante W Path Maker no longer stuns or knocks enemies back, so use your crowd control before the ultimate.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork. Activate K'Sante R All Out when Sett's main crowd control is down.
Sett.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then catch Sett with the shockwave when he moves between minions. Don't stand in a line with a minion on the opposite side of Sett, to avoid being stunned by Sett E Facebreaker.
Sett.phase: In mid game, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger as defensive items stack up. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes damage. If you deal a lot of damage, create some distance briefly; when W Haymaker comes out, use K'Sante E Footwork to move out of the center of its aim. Sett E Facebreaker needs targets on both sides of Sett to stun, so don't get caught between Sett and a group of minions.

Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Traps near objectives and in narrow passages as you move. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them. If your allies aren't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun.
Teemo.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Teemo's main damage is magic, and K'Sante has low magic resistance, so get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. Magic resistance also helps K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' damage and cooldown.
Teemo.combo: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then pull Teemo in with the shockwave. Stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, use K'Sante R All Out to push him toward a wall, then close in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Retrieve your mark with a basic attack after Teemo Q Blinding Dart's blind ends.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is your chance to go in and land basic attacks. If Teemo has also used Teemo W Move Quick, catch him with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and close the distance with K'Sante W Path Maker. Generally save K'Sante E Footwork to disengage; if you decide to engage, avoid trades where you only take a poisoned basic attack and back off.
Teemo.fight: Start trading after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he counterattacks. While blinded, don't force basic attacks; use K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes or K'Sante W Path Maker, or retreat.
Teemo.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare stacks, then catch Teemo with the shockwave when he comes close. When going in with your allied jungler, push the wave to make it harder for Teemo to escape.
Teemo.phase: The mid game, as you build defensive items, is K'Sante's strong point. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Teemo.watch: After being hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are negated, so stop attacking while blinded and use abilities or retreat. Teemo E Toxic Shot adds poison damage even from one basic attack, so stay out of range when you aren't ready to close in. Also watch for narrow paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be set and bushes without vision.

Yasuo.teamfight: Use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team and separate them if your allies can follow immediately. If your allies aren't ready, save R and hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun. K'Sante loses max health and bonus armor when activating R All Out, so engage after the enemy's main crowd control is down.
Yasuo.build: Buy armor items first. They reduce physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath, and armor also improves K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' damage and cooldown. Armor doesn't stop the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions and Yasuo with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then pull him in and stun him with the shockwave. Follow with a stun from K'Sante W Path Maker, and push him toward a wall with K'Sante R All Out when you have the angle. Close back in with K'Sante E Footwork and chain Q and basic attacks, retrieving the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack between each ability.
Yasuo.escape: The window to engage opens right after Yasuo throws the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado. Don't go in just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; look for an angle to catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. By default, save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging, and use it to engage only right after Yasuo uses a mobility ability or a key ability.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light damage before committing to a fight. Slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and retrieve the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if he retaliates. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you airborne for a while, so look for a chance to catch him with K'Sante's crowd control.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave in the middle or on your side, and don't give Yasuo more minions to dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Just before a fight, you can hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare a shockwave charge.
Yasuo.phase: K'Sante is strong in the midgame as defensive items come together. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge it as he approaches. If you get knocked airborne, he can follow up with Yasuo R Last Breath.

Aurora.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push Aurora or an enemy backline carry toward them and isolate the target. K'Sante R All Out makes K'Sante less durable, so if your allies are not ready, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun. If Aurora jumps in and no one is killed, look for an opening to catch her. When retreating, do not leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.build: In the early game, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora’s main damage is magic, so prioritize Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Aurora.combo: Build stacks on minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then pull Aurora in with the shockwave. Stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker and use K'Sante R All Out near a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, then chain attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave an attack in whenever you land an ability to proc the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark.
Aurora.escape: If one of Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds is down, check which mobility abilities she still has. Look especially for a window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back, when both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are also down. Close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork, then catch her with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave. Activate K'Sante R All Out when Aurora’s main crowd control is down.
Aurora.fight: Slow Aurora with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, proc the mark with an attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage when she retaliates. After Aurora W Across the Veil is down, look for a chance to catch her with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave. When Aurora retaliates, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to mitigate the damage and trade back.
Aurora.laning: Just before a fight, hit a minion with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then look for the shockwave when Aurora moves through the wave. Keep K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging by default.
Aurora.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as he builds defensive items. In the late game, focus on engage and crowd control more than damage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases the more health you have lost. If you are cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora. If your health is low, retreat before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds creates its zone, leaving it slows you, so escape before it appears or look for an angle to fight inside it.
