Gangplank.teamfight: If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team and isolate them. During All Out, you become less durable, and K'Sante W Path Maker loses its stun and knockback, so use any needed crowd control before transforming. If your allies are not ready, hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker.
Gangplank.build: Build armor early against Gangplank Q Parrrley and the physical damage from E Powder Keg. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage deal true damage, which resistances cannot block, so build health as well. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Gangplank.combo: After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, pull him in with the shockwave from your pre-stacked K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover the mark with a basic attack. Then stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker and follow with a basic attack before using R All Out toward a wall. After entering All Out, close in again with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so a newly placed Gangplank E Powder Keg combined with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy being down creates an opening to engage. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker, but generally save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging.
Gangplank.fight: Right after Gangplank places E Powder Keg, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct’s mark with a basic attack. If he retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork, and avoid fighting near a primed keg. Save crowd control for a guaranteed kill until after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down.
Gangplank.laning: Stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions ahead of time so you can catch Gangplank with the shockwave when he engages. If Gangplank Q Parrrley is putting heavy pressure on you, prioritize armor, and back away from primed Gangplank E Powder Kegs.
Gangplank.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as defensive items stack. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes more dangerous as it ages, so avoid primed kegs or places where two kegs overlap. Destroy kegs from outside their blast radius. If the explosion is hard to avoid, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage.

Jayce.teamfight: Look for an opportunity to get on Jayce after the leap from Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock a backline damage dealer toward your team. If your allies are not ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker.
Jayce.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Jayce’s main damage, but remember that magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Defensive items also improve K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ damage and cooldown.
Jayce.combo: Before fighting, stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions. Pull Jayce in with the shockwave, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall. Close in again with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, recovering marks with basic attacks between abilities.
Jayce.escape: The moment after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down is an opportunity to close the gap. Use K'Sante R All Out when Jayce’s main crowd control is down and your allies can follow immediately.
Jayce.fight: Slow Jayce with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover the mark with a basic attack, then disengage with K'Sante E Footwork if he retaliates. Right after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork and land K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Generally, save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging.
Jayce.laning: Keep the wave centered and dodge Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast by moving side to side. Stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then catch Jayce with the shockwave when he comes through them.
Jayce.phase: K'Sante is strong in the mid game as defensive items stack. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce sets up E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of the line. When he has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. When Jayce comes in with his combo, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and retaliate.

Pantheon.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them with K'Sante R All Out. If your team isn't ready or Pantheon W Shield Vault is still available, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the frontline with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health, and focus on defensive items that also improve K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes damage and cooldown.
Pantheon.combo: Pull Pantheon in with the stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes built on minions, then proc the mark with a basic attack and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. If Pantheon's main crowd control is down and you can push him into a wall, use K'Sante R All Out, then close in with K'Sante E Footwork and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Pantheon.escape: The moment Pantheon W Shield Vault is down is an opportunity to engage, but account for Pantheon R Grand Starfall as an escape tool if it's still available. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes when Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down and you can avoid the frontal defense from Pantheon E Aegis Assault.
Pantheon.fight: Engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, and deal damage once Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you've reached his flank.
Pantheon.laning: Put minions between you and Pantheon to reduce poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions to prepare the shockwave.
Pantheon.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun that can't be dodged while you're in range. As he leaps in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front or move around to the side.

Shen.teamfight: Alert your team if Shen disappears or you see Shen R Stand United channeling, and don't start a fight you can't finish before Shen arrives. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them. If your allies aren't ready, hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker, and use K'Sante E Footwork to reach and shield an ally who is caught.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to prepare for Shen E Shadow Dash's taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Shen.combo: Before engaging, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks. When Shen E Shadow Dash is down, pull him in with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave, retrieve your mark with a basic attack, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then basic attack again. If you can push Shen toward a wall and your allies can follow, use K'Sante R All Out, close in with K'Sante E Footwork, and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Shen.escape: Shen E Shadow Dash is Shen's only hard crowd control, so right after it misses is your chance to engage. If Shen R Stand United is also unavailable, close the distance with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Shen.fight: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and counterattack.
Shen.laning: When Shen moves between minions, hit him with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes stacks you've built in advance. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, take advantage of the empty lane and alert your team that he is moving.
Shen.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a shorter cooldown. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Shen.watch: If Shen taunts you with Shen E Shadow Dash, Shen Q Twilight Assault can empower his basic attacks and make them easy to land, so dodge the dash or charge K'Sante W Path Maker to absorb it. Also move out of the Spirit Blade's return path after Shen Q Twilight Assault. Basic attacks are negated inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge, so retrieve your mark after the zone ends.

Trundle.teamfight: Don't leave a frontliner hit by Trundle R Subjugate to face Trundle alone, and target someone else while Trundle is tankier. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them. If your allies aren't ready, save K'Sante R All Out and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker.
Trundle.build: Prioritize armor against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Defensive items also help K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' damage and cooldown, but during Trundle R Subjugate he steals your resistances, so creating distance takes priority over stacking more resistances. If healing from Trundle P King's Tribute is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Trundle.combo: Build K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes stacks on minions in advance, then pull Trundle in with the shockwave and stun him. Retrieve your K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack, stun him again with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out when you can push him toward a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Trundle.escape: Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so the chance to catch him comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down. Look for an opening when he leaves Trundle W Frozen Domain, and keep your distance until Trundle R Subjugate ends if it's active. When engaging, catch him with the prepared K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker, and generally save K'Sante E Footwork so you can get out.
Trundle.fight: Outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, slow Trundle with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and retrieve the K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack. If Trundle counterattacks, use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage and shield yourself, and back off right after being hit by Trundle Q Chomp. Catch him and fight when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle R Subjugate has ended.
Trundle.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare shockwave stacks, then catch Trundle when he moves between minions. Trundle heals whenever a minion dies through Trundle P King's Tribute, so don't drag out the lane by chipping away at his health little by little.
Trundle.phase: After Trundle gains Trundle R Subjugate, don't face him alone in a side lane. In the late game, use K'Sante's engage and crowd control in team fights.
Trundle.watch: Trundle gains strong attack speed and healing on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so step outside and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open areas and move sideways immediately when the pillar appears. When Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your defensive stats and becomes tankier, so create distance.

Yone.teamfight: Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn't hit multiple allies, and check whether Yone R Fate Sealed can reach your backline allies. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to separate an enemy backline damage dealer from their team. Otherwise, hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker.
Yone.build: K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a shorter cooldown as your armor and magic resistance increase, so prioritize defensive items. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don't focus only on one resistance or on health.
Yone.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Yone in with the shockwave and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. If Yone's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow, push him toward a wall with K'Sante R All Out and close in with K'Sante E Footwork. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to retrieve the mark.
Yone.escape: Don't engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down; check whether Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are still available too. In particular, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, and K'Sante R All Out during the window when his mobility and main crowd control are down, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.fight: When Yone's tornado Q isn't ready, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and retrieve the mark with a basic attack. If he retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. After Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave or K'Sante W Path Maker.
Yone.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and last-hit with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Before a fight, hit minions to prepare a shockwave charge.
Yone.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait out of range until the stacks expire. When he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, account for the extra damage when he returns, and watch the path of Yone R Fate Sealed and where he ends up behind it.

Gnar.teamfight: Gnar R GNAR! stuns enemies knocked into a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. Just after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini is a good time to start a team fight with your allies. If they can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to isolate an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team. Otherwise, hold the line with the shockwave from Q Ntofo Strikes and the stun from W Path Maker.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage that armor cannot block and scales with your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes deals more damage and has a shorter cooldown as you build armor.
Gnar.combo: Before fighting, stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, pull Gnar in with the shockwave, then stun him with W Path Maker. If Gnar has his back to a wall and his main crowd control is down, use R All Out to knock him into the wall, then follow with E Footwork and chain basic attacks into Q Ntofo Strikes. Weave in basic attacks between abilities to recover K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct marks.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Crunch is his mobility, so its use creates an opening for K'Sante to engage. If Gnar’s main crowd control is also down, catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, stun him with W Path Maker, then consider R All Out. You can also engage aggressively just after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini, since he cannot transform again right away.
Gnar.fight: Slow Gnar with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then recover the mark with a basic attack. If Gnar retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. Right after Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch, close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork and land Q Ntofo Strikes. Fight up close while Mega Gnar has just turned back into Mini Gnar, since he cannot transform again immediately.
Gnar.laning: Keep the wave centered and stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then catch Gnar with the shockwave when he gets close. If you cannot get on top of Mini Gnar, farm near your turret and wait for his transformation cycle.
Gnar.phase: K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger in the mid game as you build defensive items. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit on both the way out and the way back, so step out of its path. When Gnar’s rage is building and his transformation is near, create distance and avoid standing with your back to a wall where Mega Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into it.

Kayle.teamfight: Create a direct path to Kayle from the flank or outside her vision so she can't keep attacking from the back, and time your engage with your team's crowd control. When you knock Kayle toward your allies with K'Sante R All Out, they need to be able to follow up immediately.
Kayle.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kayle's main damage is magic, and K'Sante has low magic resistance, so get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Kayle.combo: Hit a minion with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build stacks, then pull Kayle in with the shockwave and proc the mark with a basic attack. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun her, then land a basic attack. If you can use a wall, knock her away with K'Sante R All Out. During All Out, use K'Sante E Footwork to close back in and chain basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, use crowd control first to let the damage immunity run out, then deal damage.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility, but she can use Kayle W Celestial Blessing for movement speed to get away, so engage after she uses it or when the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes catches her. After Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses, you also have an opening to close the gap without worrying about its slow. Save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging by default, and use it to engage only when one of these openings appears.
Kayle.fight: Slow Kayle with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then proc the mark with a basic attack. If she retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. Look for an opening to engage if Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or right after she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Kayle.laning: Keep the wave in the center, last-hit with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and build Q stacks on minions in advance. Kayle has no mobility, so she is vulnerable to ganks; call your jungler and engage with crowd control first.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers K'Sante's armor and magic resistance and slows him, so avoid taking it directly. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be especially careful at low health. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don't unload damage; keep her locked down with crowd control until the damage immunity ends.

Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn't pull several of you in, and keep your distance with the slow from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. If your allies can follow up immediately, knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward them with K'Sante R All Out. If there isn't an opening, hold the frontline with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun, and use K'Sante E Footwork to reach an ally who's been caught and shield them.
Mordekaiser.build: Hold out with Null-Magic Mantle early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mordekaiser's main damage is magic, so get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early to raise your magic resistance. Also build armor against his basic-attack damage, and if the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Mordekaiser.combo: Before fighting, build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Mordekaiser in with the shockwave and stun him. Proc the mark with a basic attack, stun him again with K'Sante W Path Maker, then use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork, chaining basic attacks with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proccing the mark with basic attacks between abilities.
Mordekaiser.escape: Once Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, you have an opening to engage. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance, so catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes then close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork. However, if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.fight: Slow Mordekaiser with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then proc the mark with a basic attack. If he retaliates, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork. As Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack. Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible grants its shield, don't unload your damage; attack once the shield is depleted or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Build stacks in advance by hitting minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then catch Mordekaiser with the shockwave when he moves between minions. Trade briefly and disengage so you don't activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Mordekaiser.phase: K'Sante is strong in mid game as defensive items build up, and in the late game you should focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, it's easy to get hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise in quick succession, so keep your distance in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits from abilities or basic attacks, so end the trade and back off within two hits. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone.

Poppy.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and peel that target away. During All Out, K'Sante's maximum health, bonus armor, and bonus magic resistance are reduced, so delay your engage if Poppy's main crowd control is still available. If your allies aren't ready, hold the frontline with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker's stun.
Poppy.build: Build armor first to mitigate the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes still gains damage and a lower cooldown from armor, and you don't need to prioritize magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Poppy in with the shockwave and proc the mark with a basic attack. Follow with K'Sante W Path Maker to stun her and weave in a basic attack, then use K'Sante R All Out when you can push her toward a wall. After entering All Out, follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Poppy.escape: The moment Poppy E Heroic Charge is used is your chance to close the gap. Confirm Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and follow up with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork if needed. Use K'Sante R All Out when Poppy's main crowd control is down and your allies can follow up immediately.
Poppy.fight: For short trades, slow Poppy with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if she retaliates. Close the gap after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used and Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends. As Poppy E Heroic Charge comes in, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage and counterattack.
Poppy.laning: Hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to build shockwave stacks in advance, then catch Poppy when she moves between minions. Don't stand with your back to a wall, and, if possible, step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador to prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash in with K'Sante E Footwork or K'Sante W Path Maker; wait for it to end or walk up. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so stand in open space. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the area before its second hit. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her line of fire.

Tryndamere.teamfight: If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer toward them and separate them. If your allies aren't ready, save R and hold the line with the K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave and K'Sante W Path Maker stun. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with crowd control instead of focusing damage, and don't go alone to stop Tryndamere in a side lane while his R is available.
Tryndamere.build: Prioritize armor against Tryndamere's main physical damage. Since he relies heavily on basic attacks, Thornmail is effective; if healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Tryndamere.combo: Before engaging, hit minions with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes to prepare shockwave stacks. When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, pull him in with the Q shockwave and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker, then push him into a wall with K'Sante R All Out if you have the angle. Follow with K'Sante E Footwork and chain Q with basic attacks, retrieving your K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct mark with a basic attack between abilities. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't try to finish him with this combo.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after making Tryndamere use E Spinning Slash is your window to engage as K'Sante. Close the distance then with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork and catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Right after Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, your attack damage is reduced, so delay basic attack trades.
Tryndamere.fight: Catch Tryndamere with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and fight right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't try to finish the duel; wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.laning: If you can contest Tryndamere's last hits, suppress his Fury and healing at the same time, but create distance first when you see him building Fury. When retreating, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, and avoid fighting with basic attacks right after W hits you.
Tryndamere.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains damage and a shorter cooldown. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control rather than damage.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere can crit with Tryndamere P Battle Fury, so create distance when he starts building Fury by hitting minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash has its cooldown reduced by critical strikes, so don't chase him where there are many minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can't be killed, so buy time with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and K'Sante W Path Maker or create distance instead of dumping your damage.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so build health too rather than relying on resistances alone. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your defensive items.
Garen.combo: Pre-stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Garen in with the shockwave after his Q Decisive Strike empowered attack is expended. Once Garen W Courage’s brief defensive window ends, stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker and use R All Out on Garen with his back to a wall. Then close in with K'Sante E Footwork, chain Q into basic attacks, and recover marks between abilities.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility, so the window to engage opens after his Q Decisive Strike empowered attack is expended. If he activates W Courage, wait for its brief shield and tenacity to wear off, then catch him with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker. Generally, save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging.
Garen.fight: Right after Garen’s empowered basic attack from Q Decisive Strike is expended, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover the mark with a basic attack. If Garen retaliates or activates E Judgment, disengage with K'Sante E Footwork for a short trade. Engage by catching him when his main abilities are down and the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes is ready.
Garen.laning: When you can apply pressure safely, limit Garen’s opportunities to build stacks on W Courage, but do not force the wave forward and drag out a fight.
Garen.phase: In the mid game, as you build defensive items, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes deals more damage and has a shorter cooldown. Garen W Courage’s stacking passive puts you at an increasing disadvantage over time, so apply safe pressure from the early game to limit his opportunities to stack it. In the late game, contribute through engaging and crowd control.
Garen.teamfight: If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team and isolate them. If your allies are far away, save R and hold the line with the shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker. After using R, you become less durable and W loses its stun, so make sure you can stay close and attack.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next basic attack and silences, so do not engage first while it is active. When Garen E Judgment starts, use K'Sante E Footwork to leave its spin range. After Garen W Courage, delay your crowd control by half a beat. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice.

Jax.build: Build defensive items first to improve K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ damage and cooldown. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Lowering attack speed is also effective given Jax’s reliance on basic attacks.
Jax.combo: Stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Jax in with the shockwave and stun him with K'Sante W Path Maker. If Jax E Counter Strike is down and you have an angle to knock him into a wall, use K'Sante R All Out, then follow with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks into K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop even the basic attacks you would use to recover marks.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are down is an opening to engage. Catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, follow with a stun from K'Sante W Path Maker, then decide whether to engage with K'Sante R All Out. If both abilities are still available, save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging.
Jax.fight: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, slow him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and recover the mark with a basic attack. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, do not use basic attacks and save K'Sante E Footwork for disengaging. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, look for an opportunity to catch him with K'Sante W Path Maker.
Jax.laning: Keep the wave centered and stack K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then look for the shockwave when Jax engages.
Jax.phase: In the mid game, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gets stronger as K'Sante builds defensive items. In the late game, focus on engaging and applying crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax engages with E Counter Strike active, spread out to avoid the area stun, then catch him with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and W Path Maker as soon as the stun ends. If your allies can follow immediately, use K'Sante R All Out to knock an enemy backline damage dealer toward your team.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it negates basic attacks, and its recast damage and stun are dangerous. Stop attacking and use K'Sante E Footwork to get outside the stun range. When Jax closes in with Q Leap Strike, charge K'Sante W Path Maker to reduce the damage.

Quinn.build: Buy defensive items first to prepare for Quinn's physical damage and build armor. K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes gains both damage and a lower cooldown as your armor increases.
Quinn.combo: Build stacks of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes on minions, then pull Quinn in with the shockwave and proc the mark with a basic attack. Stun her with K'Sante W Path Maker, weave in a basic attack, then use K'Sante R All Out toward a wall. Follow up with K'Sante E Footwork and chain basic attacks and Q.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is her escape tool, so its use creates an opening to engage. Close the gap with K'Sante W Path Maker or K'Sante E Footwork then, and land K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
Quinn.fight: Close the gap right after Quinn E Vault is used. Slow her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and proc the mark with a basic attack, then use K'Sante E Footwork to disengage if she retaliates.
Quinn.laning: Keep the wave near the center and hit minions with Q to build stacks, but don't start a fight alone while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.phase: Quinn's range gives her the advantage early, so K'Sante should focus on farming CS and preserving health. In the late game, focus on engaging and crowd control over damage, and warn your team early if Quinn roams.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn flanks, catch her with K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes' shockwave or K'Sante W Path Maker. Use K'Sante R All Out to push an enemy backline damage dealer away toward your allies only when they can follow up immediately.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move outside her basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind minions to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don't force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.
